justification: Inspected [byte-buddy-dep/src/main/java/net/bytebuddy/description/type/TypeList.java](byte-buddy-dep/src/main/java/net/bytebuddy/description/type/TypeList.java) and [byte-buddy-dep/src/main/java/net/bytebuddy/matcher/FilterableList.java](byte-buddy-dep/src/main/java/net/bytebuddy/matcher/FilterableList.java). `TypeList.Empty` has no fields and only 3 trivial overrides (`toInternalNames`, `getStackSize`, `asGenericTypes`); the generic empty-list behavior is inherited from `FilterableList.Empty`. The dedicated test [byte-buddy-dep/src/test/java/net/bytebuddy/description/type/TypeListEmptyTest.java](byte-buddy-dep/src/test/java/net/bytebuddy/description/type/TypeListEmptyTest.java) only checks empty-list return values, with no sign of multiple responsibilities or a need to split the class further.
